newsitem.title: INDIA: India says no major budget tax, customs changes.
newsitem.headline: India says no major budget tax, customs changes.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Wednesday the government had not made any major changes to proposals on taxation and customs duties in the 1997/98 (April-March) federal budget.
"No major changes have been made in taxation and on customs duties," Chidambaram told parliament.
The finance minister was speaking to the lower house of parliament after moving the Finance Bill, covering tax and tariff proposals for 1997/98.
The bill was introduced on February 28, and parliament is expected to be vote on it this week.
Chidambaram said changes in customs and excise duties which the government was proposing after holding discussions with industry and political parties would reduce revenues by 1.11 billion rupees.
